LESSON: WORD AND SENTENCE FORMATION

Grade: Grade 2
Subject: LITERACY ACTIVITIES
Strand: WRITING
Topic 4.1: Word and sentence formation

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Word and sentence formation. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. use familiar words and 3 lessons sentences
2. use the correct noun and verb form in making sentences
3. identify and write upper and lower case letters in words and sentences correctly
4. develop an interest in writing for pleasure Core-Competence to be developed: Communication and collaboration: learners perform collaborative activities e.g. rearranging sentences to form paragraphs

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. use familiar words and 3 lessons sentences
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to use familiar words and 3 lessons sentences. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. use the correct noun and verb form in making sentences
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to use the correct noun and verb form in making sentences. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

3. identify and write upper and lower case letters in words and sentences correctly
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to identify and write upper and lower case letters in words and sentences correctly. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

4. develop an interest in writing for pleasure Core-Competence to be developed: Communication and collaboration: learners perform collaborative activities e.g. rearranging sentences to form paragraphs
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to develop an interest in writing for pleasure Core-Competence to be developed: Communication and collaboration: learners perform collaborative activities e.g. rearranging sentences to form paragraphs. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Word and sentence formation using something you see at school.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Word and sentence formation.
2. Explain Word and sentence formation to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Word and sentence formation.
4. Show that you can: use familiar words and 3 lessons sentences
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Word and sentence formation. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is Word and sentence formation important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. use familiar words and 3 lessons sentences
2. use the correct noun and verb form in making sentences
3. identify and write upper and lower case letters in words and sentences correctly
4. develop an interest in writing for pleasure Core-Competence to be developed: Communication and collaboration: learners perform collaborative activities e.g. rearranging sentences to form paragraphs

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Learner lesson
